questions.question: Dinesh can row at 18 Km/h in still water. If speed of stream is 6 Km/h, then how long will Dinesh take to row upto a distance of 6km and return to the starting point?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Speed of Dinesh in still water = 18 km/hr

Speed of stream = 6 km/hr

**Concept used:**

Speed upstream = Speed of Dinesh in still water - Speed of stream 

Speed downstream = Speed of Dinesh in still water + Speed of stream 

**Calculation:**

According to the above concept

Speed upstream = Speed of Dinesh in still water - Speed of stream 

⇒ (18 - 6) km/hr = 12 km/hr

Speed downstream = Speed of Dinesh in still water + Speed of stream 

⇒ (18 + 6) km/hr = 24 km/hr

Total time taken to row up 6 km and return = (Distance/Speed upstream) + (Distance/Speed downstream)

⇒ ((6)/({12)} + (6)/({24)}) = ((12 + 6)/({24)}) hour

⇒ (18)/({24)} hour = (3)/({4)} hour

⇒ ((3)/({4)} × 60) min =** 45 min**

**∴ The required time is 45 min.**

The ratio of the ages of A and B is 3 ∶ 2. Ten years hence, the sum of their ages will be 80. What are their respective present ages (in years ) ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of present ages = 80 − (10 × 2) = 60 years.

Total ratio parts of A and B = 3 + 2 = 5 parts.

Value of 1 part = 60 ÷ 5 = 12 years.

A's present age = 3 × 12 = 36 years.

B's present age = 2 × 12 = 24 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 36, 24 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Present age ratio of A and B = 3 : 2

Sum of their ages 10 years hence = 80 years

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6d599aaaefe684bd777f19a91f06ae1c2c6854ab2d8a88ab359432054f453be.png] 

**Calculation:**

Let the present ages of A and B be 3x and 2x respectively.

Sum of their present ages = 3x + 2x = 5x

Sum of their ages after 10 years = (3x + 10) + (2x + 10)

⇒ 5x + 20 = 80

⇒ 5x = 80 − 20

⇒ 5x = 60

⇒ x = 12

⇒ Present age of A = 3x = 3 × 12 = 36 years

⇒ Present age of B = 2x = 2 × 12 = 24 years

**∴ The correct answer is 36, 24 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Ages over Time

If the present sum of the ages of n persons is S, then the sum of their ages after t years will be S + (n × t).

Constant Age Difference

The difference between the ages of two persons remains constant over time. If a person is 5 years older today, they will always remain 5 years older.

Cross-Multiplication Method

When an age ratio changes from a:b to c:d after t years, the value of 1 ratio part is given by [t × (c − d)] ÷ (ad − bc).

A man sells a mobile phone for ₹680 and loses something. If he had sold it for ₹1070, his gain would have been double the former loss. The cost price (in ₹) of the mobile phone is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Loss to Gain = 1 : 2

Total difference in parts = 1 + 2 = 3 parts

Difference in Selling Prices = ₹1070 − ₹680 = ₹390

3 parts = ₹390 ⇒ 1 part (Loss) = ₹130

Cost Price = SP₁ + Loss = 680 + 130 = ₹810

**∴ The correct answer is ₹810.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price 1 (SP₁) = ₹680

Selling Price 2 (SP₂) = ₹1070

Gain at SP₂ is double the loss at SP₁.

**Formula Used:**

Loss = Cost Price (CP) − Selling Price (SP)

Gain = Selling Price (SP) − Cost Price (CP)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/965b97fcbf17900746e668142b0794a53bfb12e4c6a5da25145a3aafe2f04174.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the Cost Price of the mobile phone be CP.

⇒ Loss when sold at ₹680 = CP − 680

⇒ Gain when sold at ₹1070 = 1070 − CP

⇒ According to the given condition: Gain = 2 × Loss

⇒ 1070 − CP = 2 × (CP − 680)

⇒ 1070 − CP = 2CP − 1360

⇒ 3CP = 1070 + 1360

⇒ 3CP = 2430

⇒ CP = 2430 ÷ 3 = ₹810

**∴ The correct answer is ₹810.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cost Price (CP) & Selling Price (SP)

Cost Price is the amount paid to purchase an article. Selling Price is the amount at which the article is sold to the customer.

Profit & Loss Basics

Profit occurs when the Selling Price is greater than the Cost Price (Profit = SP − CP). Loss occurs when the Cost Price is greater than the Selling Price (Loss = CP − SP).

Marked Price & Discount

Discount is a reduction given on the Marked Price (MP) of an article before selling. It is calculated as: Selling Price = MP − Discount.

questions.question: Two inlet pipes can separately fill a cistern completely in 8 hours and 10 hours, respectively. They are operated for 2 hours, after which the second pipe is closed, and an outlet pipe which can drain out water from the full cistern in 20 hours is opened. How much time will it take to fill the cistern completely from the instant of opening the outlet pipe?
questions.solution:
Given:

Two inlet pipes can separately fill a cistern completely in 8 hours and 10 hours, respectively. They are operated for 2 hours, after which the second pipe is closed, and an outlet pipe which can drain out water from the full cistern in 20 hours is opened. 

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency (Work done per hour) × Total time taken 

1 hour = 60 minutes

Calculation:

LCM (8, 10) = 40

Let the capacity of the tank be the LCM of 8, 10.

Hence, the capacity of the tank = 40 units

Efficiencies (per hour),

First pipe = 40 ÷ 8 = 5 units

Second pipe = 40 ÷ 10 = 4 units

Outlet pipe = 40 ÷ 20 = 2 units

In first two hours, tank was filled by = 2 × (5 + 4) = 18 units

Remaining = 40 - 18 = 22 units

Here, the efficiency is taken negative since it's draining the water outside. 

Then, taken taken to fill the tank = 22 over (5 - 2) = 71 over 3 hours = 7 hours 20 minutes 

**∴ It will take to fill the cistern completely from the instant of opening the outlet pipe 7 hours 20 minutes.**

questions.question: A cylindrical tank of radius 2{1over 2} m and height 3 m is full of water. If 47.1 kilolitre water is taken out from the tank, then to what percent does the water level drop in the tank? (Take π = 3.14)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Volume (V) = πr²h = 3.14 × (2.5)² × 3 = 58.875 m³.

Volume of water removed = 47.1 kilolitres = 47.1 m³.

Remaining Volume = 58.875 − 47.1 = 11.775 m³.

Percentage level drop to = (Remaining Volume ÷ Total Volume) × 100.

⇒ (11.775 ÷ 58.875) × 100 = 1/5 × 100 = 20%.

**∴ The correct answer is 20%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius (r) = 2.5 m = 5/2 m

Height (H) = 3 m

Water removed = 47.1 kilolitres = 47.1 m³ (since 1 kl = 1 m³)

π = 3.14

**Formula Used:**

Volume of Cylinder = πr²h

Percentage level = (Current Height ÷ Total Height) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad3761bb8c7ee24740254946bede440d4ab6d7f103f44ad256f7561c9a06bba6.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Base Area of tank = πr²

⇒ Base Area = 3.14 × (2.5)² = 3.14 × 6.25 = 19.625 m²

⇒ Height of water removed (hᵣₑₘₒvₑd) = Volume removed ÷ Base Area

⇒ hᵣₑₘₒvₑd = 47.1 ÷ 19.625 = 2.4 m

⇒ New water level height = Total Height − Height removed

⇒ New height = 3 − 2.4 = 0.6 m

⇒ Percentage drop to = (New height ÷ Total height) × 100

⇒ Percentage drop to = (0.6 ÷ 3) × 100

⇒ Percentage drop to = 0.2 × 100 = 20%

**∴ The correct answer is 20%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cylinder

The volume of a cylinder with radius r and height h is given by V = πr²h.

Kilolitre and Cubic Meter Relationship

1 kilolitre (kl) is exactly equal to 1 cubic meter (m³). 1 litre = 1000 cm³.

Percentage Level in Uniform Cross-section

For a tank with a uniform base (like a cylinder or prism), the percentage of volume is directly proportional to the percentage of height.</p

questions.question: Find the value of tan 72º - tan 27º - tan 72º tan 27º.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since 72° − 27° = 45°, we use the identity tan(A − B) = (tan A − tan B) / (1 + tan A × tan B).

⇒ tan(72° − 27°) = (tan 72° − tan 27°) / (1 + tan 72° × tan 27°)

⇒ tan 45° = (tan 72° − tan 27°) / (1 + tan 72° × tan 27°)

⇒ 1 = (tan 72° − tan 27°) / (1 + tan 72° × tan 27°)

⇒ 1 + tan 72° × tan 27° = tan 72° − tan 27°

⇒ tan 72° − tan 27° − tan 72° × tan 27° = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: tan 72° − tan 27° − tan 72° × tan 27°

**Formula Used:**

tan(A − B) = (tan A − tan B) / (1 + tan A × tan B)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let A = 72° and B = 27°

⇒ A − B = 72° − 27° = 45°

⇒ tan(72° − 27°) = (tan 72° − tan 27°) / (1 + tan 72° × tan 27°)

⇒ tan 45° = (tan 72° − tan 27°) / (1 + tan 72° × tan 27°)

We know that tan 45° = 1

⇒ 1 = (tan 72° − tan 27°) / (1 + tan 72° × tan 27°)

⇒ 1 + tan 72° × tan 27° = tan 72° − tan 27°

⇒ tan 72° − tan 27° − tan 72° × tan 27° = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Tangent Addition Formula

tan(A + B) = (tan A + tan B) / (1 − tan A × tan B)

Tangent Subtraction Formula

tan(A − B) = (tan A − tan B) / (1 + tan A × tan B)

Tangent Double Angle Formula

tan 2A = (2 × tan A) / (1 − tan² A)

Key Trigonometric Values

tan 45° = 1, tan 135° = −1

questions.question: Let P and Q be two towers with the same base. Exactly midway between the foot of the two towers P and Q, the angels of elevation of their tops are 30º and 60º, respectively.The ratio of the heights of Q to P is :
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For two objects at equal distance from an observation point, the ratio of their heights is the ratio of the tangents of their angles of elevation.

Height of Q : Height of P = tan 60° : tan 30°

Ratio = √3 : (1/√3)

Ratio = (√3 × √3) : 1 = 3 : 1

**∴ The correct answer is 3 : 1.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: Midway point M between foot of tower P and tower Q. Angles of elevation θP = 30° and θQ = 60°.

Formula: tan θ = Height / Distance

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02d3d1a6cb2a90d93fb2e4f2f8b6f4055c72b3b22b0ee1c9690b59dd4524eceb.png] 

Let the distance from midpoint M to each tower base be d.

⇒ In triangle for tower P: tan 30° = HeightP / d

⇒ HeightP = d × (1/√3)

⇒ In triangle for tower Q: tan 60° = HeightQ / d

⇒ HeightQ = d × √3

⇒ Ratio Q : P = HeightQ / HeightP = (d × √3) / (d / √3)

⇒ Ratio = √3 × √3 = 3 / 1

**∴ The correct answer is 3 : 1.**

**__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Ratios

Key values: tan 30° = 1/√3, tan 45° = 1, tan 60° = √3. These are derived from right-angled triangle properties.

Angle of Elevation

The angle formed by the line of sight with the horizontal when looking up at an object. It is equal to the angle of depression from the top of the object to the observer.

Proportionality Rule

When the base distance is constant, height (h) is directly proportional to the tangent of the angle of elevation (θ). Formula: h₁/h₂ = tan θ₁ / tan θ₂.</p

questions.question: Five years ago, the average age of Puneet and Amrita was 15 years. Today the average age of Puneet, Amrita and Renu is 20 years. What will be the age of Renu after 12 years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Five years ago, the average age of Puneet and Amrita was 15 years.

Today the average age of Puneet, Amrita and Renu is 20 years.

**Formula used:**

Average × number of observation = sum of observation

**Calculations:**

When, average of Puneet and Amrita before 5 years ago was 15,

Puneet - 5 + Amrita - 5 = 15 × 2

=> Puneet + Amrita = 30 + 5 + 5

=> Puneet + Amrita = 40

Now, again, when average of the three = 20

Puneet + Amrita + Renu = 20 × 3 = 60

=> Renu = 60 - 40 = 20 (putting the summation of Puneet and Amrita)

Required age of Renu after 12 years = 20 + 12 = 32 years

**∴ The answer is 32 years.**

questions.question: If x is subtracted from each of 52, 47, 20 and 19, the number so obtained in this order are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between (x + 13) and (x - 8)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For numbers a, b, c, d to be in proportion when x is subtracted: x = (ad − bc) ÷ ((a + d) − (b + c))

Here, a = 52, b = 47, c = 20, d = 19

x = (52 × 19 − 47 × 20) ÷ ((52 + 19) − (47 + 20)) = (988 − 940) ÷ (71 − 67) = 48 ÷ 4 = 12

Mean proportional between (x + 13) and (x − 8) = √((12 + 13) × (12 − 8)) = √(25 × 4) = √100 = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers: 52, 47, 20, 19

When x is subtracted from each, they become proportional.

**Formula Used:**

If a, b, c, and d are in proportion, then a ÷ b = c ÷ d.

Mean proportional between two numbers p and q = √(p × q)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4d3826141a9fdd439c4410d6fbe8fa43baf6014e65dc5053757c47b7ae57d90.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (52 − x) : (47 − x) :: (20 − x) : (19 − x)

⇒ (52 − x) ÷ (47 − x) = (20 − x) ÷ (19 − x)

⇒ (52 − x)(19 − x) = (20 − x)(47 − x)

⇒ 988 − 52x − 19x + x² = 940 − 20x − 47x + x²

⇒ 988 − 71x = 940 − 67x

⇒ 71x − 67x = 988 − 940

⇒ 4x = 48

⇒ x = 12

Now, finding the given terms to calculate the mean proportional:

⇒ First term = (x + 13) = 12 + 13 = 25

⇒ Second term = (x − 8) = 12 − 8 = 4

⇒ Mean proportional = √(25 × 4) = √100 = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is given by √(a × b). It represents the value x such that a : x :: x : b.

Third Proportional

If a, b, and c are in continued proportion (a : b :: b : c), then c is the third proportional to a and b. Formula: c = b² ÷ a.

Fourth Proportional

For numbers a, b, and c, the fourth proportional is x such that a : b :: c : x. Formula: x = (b × c) ÷ a.

Componendo and Dividendo

If a ÷ b = c ÷ d, then applying Componendo and Dividendo gives (a + b) ÷ (a − b) = (c + d) ÷ (c − d). This rule is widely used to simplify complex ratios.
</p

questions.question: The cost of painting the surface of a large spherical ball at the rate of ₹2.40 per cm² is ₹9,240. What is the radius (in cm) of the ball? (Use pi = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost of painting the surface of a spherical ball = ₹9,240

Rate of painting per cm² = ₹2.40

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Surface Area of Sphere = 4 × π × r²

Total Cost = Surface Area × Rate per cm²

**Calculation:**

Total Cost = ₹9,240

Rate per cm² = ₹2.40

Surface Area = Total Cost / Rate per cm²

Surface Area = 9240 / 2.40

Surface Area = 3850 cm²

Surface Area = 4 × π × r²

⇒ 3850 = 4 × 22/7 × r²

⇒ r² = 3850 × 7 / (4 × 22)

⇒ r² = 3850 × 7 / 88

⇒ r² = 306.25

⇒ r = √306.25

⇒ r = 17.5 cm

**The radius of the spherical ball is 17.5 cm.**

questions.question: PQRS is a cyclic quadrilateral in which ∠P = (2x + 7°) ,∠Q = (x + 12°),∠R = (4y – 7°), and ∠S = (5y + 3°). Find the value of (x + y)
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

In a cyclic quadrilateral, opposite angles sum to 180°.

∠P + ∠R = 180° → (2x + 7) + (4y − 7) = 180 → x + 2y = 90

∠Q + ∠S = 180° → (x + 12) + (5y + 3) = 180 → x + 5y = 165

Subtracting the equations: (x + 5y) − (x + 2y) = 165 − 90 → 3y = 75 → y = 25

Substituting y: x + 2(25) = 90 → x = 40

x + y = 40 + 25 = 65°

**∴ The correct answer is 65°.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: ∠P = (2x + 7°), ∠Q = (x + 12°), ∠R = (4y − 7°), and ∠S = (5y + 3°).

Formula Used: In a cyclic quadrilateral, ∠P + ∠R = 180° and ∠Q + ∠S = 180°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56b4db1e069f2f4c65820ecd73c2c97f59101a0203735905f36dbdbe0cab61f2.png] 

⇒ ∠P + ∠R = 180°

⇒ (2x + 7°) + (4y − 7°) = 180°

⇒ 2x + 4y = 180°

⇒ x + 2y = 90° ---- (Eq. 1)

⇒ ∠Q + ∠S = 180°

⇒ (x + 12°) + (5y + 3°) = 180°

⇒ x + 5y + 15° = 180°

⇒ x + 5y = 165° ---- (Eq. 2)

⇒ Subtracting (Eq. 1) from (Eq. 2):

⇒ (x + 5y) − (x + 2y) = 165° − 90°

⇒ 3y = 75°

⇒ y = 25°

⇒ Substitute y = 25° in (Eq. 1):

⇒ x + 2(25°) = 90°

⇒ x + 50° = 90°

⇒ x = 40°

⇒ Value of (x + y) = 40° + 25° = 65°

**∴ The correct answer is 65°.**

**__Additional Information__**

Cyclic Quadrilateral Property

A quadrilateral is cyclic if and only if its opposite angles are supplementary, i.e., sum is 180°.

Exterior Angle of Cyclic Quadrilateral

The exterior angle formed by extending one side of a cyclic quadrilateral is equal to the interior opposite angle.

Ptolemy Theorem

For a cyclic quadrilateral with sides a, b, c, d and diagonals p, q: (p × q) = (a × c) + (b × d).</p

questions.question:
Read the statements given below carefully and state which of the following conclusions is correct in the context of the statements.

statement:

I. Last Sunday, on the 15th of the month, there was a crowd of tourists at the Taj Mahal.

II. The authorities have decided to keep the Taj Mahal closed for repairs from the 17th of the month.

options.text: Statement I is the cause, and Statement II is its effect.
Statement I and Statement II are effects of a common cause.
Statement II is the reason, and statement I is an effect.
Statement I and Statement II are different reasons.

questions.solution:
**Statements:**

**The Cause (Statement II):** The authorities decided to close the Taj Mahal for repairs starting from the **17th** of the month. Once such a decision is made and announced, it creates a deadline for potential visitors.

**The Effect (Statement I):** Because the monument was scheduled to close on the 17th, tourists likely rushed to visit it on the last available Sunday (the **15th**) before the closure. This explains the specific "crowd of tourists" mentioned in the first statement.

In reasoning tests, when one event (a future restriction) logically explains the intensity or occurrence of a preceding event (a sudden rush or crowd), it is treated as a **Cause and Effect** relationship.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
